title: Imperial Star Destroyer — Kuat departure
description: A dagger-shaped Imperial Star Destroyer rises above an orbital drydock while two TIE escorts emerge beneath its open ventral hangar. Eight heavy batteries, sloped armour, a recessed hull trench, triangular command terraces, the broad T bridge, twin shield generators and seven blue aft exhausts define the warship.
